source_meta._title: Acacia hanging signs cannot be crafted

stor.environment: Minecraft: Java Edition snapshot 22w42a in an unmodded single-player Creative-mode world with cheats enabled and the built-in Update 1.20 experimental data pack enabled during world creation. Use the standard crafting-table interface. The instructions assume default keyboard and mouse controls and English item names.
preconditions: Install and launch the exact Java Edition snapshot 22w42a, not the fixed snapshot 22w43a or a later version.
Create a new disposable world; the Update 1.20 experimental features must be enabled during world creation and cannot be added to an already-created 22w42a world.
Do not load additional data packs, mods, or server plugins that replace recipes.
Use Creative mode for deterministic item acquisition. This is an execution choice; the report does not require a particular game mode.
Have at least one Crafting Table, two Chains, and six Stripped Acacia Logs available before beginning the manual crafting attempt.

steps.action: Start Minecraft: Java Edition using the launcher installation configured for snapshot 22w42a. At the title screen, verify that the displayed version is 22w42a before proceeding.
steps.success_cue: The title screen identifies the running version as Minecraft Java Edition 22w42a.

steps.action: Select Singleplayer, choose Create New World, set Game Mode to Creative, and set Allow Cheats to ON. The single-player Creative configuration is used only to obtain the required items reliably.
steps.exact_input: Singleplayer -> Create New World -> Game Mode: Creative -> Allow Cheats: ON
steps.success_cue: The world-creation screen shows Creative mode and cheats enabled.

steps.action: While still creating the new world, open the Data Packs screen. Find the built-in Update 1.20 experimental pack, which may be displayed as “Update 1.20” or by its internal-style name “update_1_20”, and move it from Available to Selected using its arrow button. Select Done afterward.
steps.exact_input: Create New World -> Data Packs -> enable Update 1.20/update_1_20 -> Done
steps.success_cue: The Update 1.20 experimental data pack is in the selected/enabled data-pack list.

steps.action: If an experimental-feature warning appears, accept the warning and continue. Select Create New World.
steps.exact_input: Proceed, if prompted -> Create New World
steps.success_cue: The new world begins loading with the experimental pack enabled.

steps.action: Wait until the player is in the world, surrounding terrain has rendered, and movement responds normally. Do not begin the crafting test while the world is still loading.
steps.success_cue: The player can move normally in the loaded Creative world.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory using the inventory control, whose default key is E, and select the Search Items tab.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory is open and a text search field is available.

steps.action: Click the search field and enter “Acacia Hanging Sign” to verify that the Update 1.20 experimental content is active. Do not take the hanging sign item; this search is only a setup check.
steps.success_cue: An Acacia Hanging Sign item appears among the Creative search results, confirming that the experimental content is enabled.

steps.action: Replace the search text with “Crafting Table”. Left-click the Crafting Table item in the results to pick up a stack, then left-click an empty hotbar slot—the hotbar is the nine-slot row at the bottom of the screen—to place it there.
steps.success_cue: A Crafting Table is present in one of the nine hotbar slots.

steps.action: Replace the search text with “Chain”. Pick up the Chain item and place its stack into a different hotbar or player-inventory slot. At least two Chains are required.
steps.success_cue: The player inventory contains at least two Chains.

steps.action: Replace the search text with “Stripped Acacia Log”. Pick up the Stripped Acacia Log item and place its stack into another hotbar or player-inventory slot. At least six logs are required. Do not substitute Acacia Logs, Acacia Wood, Stripped Acacia Wood, planks, or another tree species.
steps.success_cue: The player inventory contains at least six items named Stripped Acacia Log.

steps.action: Close the inventory with E. Select the hotbar slot containing the Crafting Table using the corresponding number key or the mouse wheel. Aim at a clear ground block within reach and use the selected table with right-click to place it.
steps.exact_input: E; select the Crafting Table hotbar slot; right-click a clear ground block
steps.success_cue: A Crafting Table block is placed in the world within the player's reach.

steps.action: Optional diagnostic from the report: press T to open in-game chat, enter the report's command exactly as written with the leading slash, and press Enter. Cheats must be enabled for this command.
steps.success_cue: Command feedback indicates that recipes were granted to the player or players. If this optional diagnostic is skipped, continue to the next step.

steps.action: Aim at the placed Crafting Table and right-click it to open the 3-by-3 crafting interface.
steps.success_cue: The Crafting Table interface is open, showing a 3-by-3 input grid and an output slot.

steps.action: Optional diagnostic, only if step 12 was performed: click the recipe-book button in the Crafting Table interface, select its search field, and type “Hanging Sign”. Locate the Acacia Hanging Sign entry. Do not rely on recipe auto-fill for the primary reproduction and do not take anything from the output slot.
steps.exact_input: Click Recipe Book -> click search field -> type Hanging Sign
steps.success_cue: The recipe-book search is filtered to hanging-sign recipes and the Acacia Hanging Sign entry can be located. The crafting interface remains open.

steps.action: Prepare for the manual crafting attempt. Close the recipe-book panel if it obstructs the grid. Remove any items or ghost-filled ingredients from the 3-by-3 crafting input grid so that all nine input cells are visibly empty before manually arranging the ingredients.
steps.exact_input: Click the Recipe Book button if necessary; clear all nine crafting-grid cells
steps.success_cue: All nine input cells in the Crafting Table grid are empty, and the Chain and Stripped Acacia Log stacks remain accessible in the player inventory.

steps.action: Place one Chain in the top-left crafting-grid cell and one Chain in the top-right cell, leaving the top-center cell empty. To place single items from a stack, left-click the Chain stack to hold it on the cursor, right-click each required grid cell once, and return the remaining stack to its inventory slot.
steps.exact_input: Chain layout: top-left = 1 Chain; top-center = empty; top-right = 1 Chain
steps.success_cue: The top crafting row contains Chain, empty cell, Chain in that order, with exactly one Chain in each occupied cell.

steps.action: Place one Stripped Acacia Log into each of the three cells in the middle row. Then place one Stripped Acacia Log in the bottom-left cell and one in the bottom-center cell. Deliberately leave the bottom-right cell empty so that the final placement can be isolated as the trigger action.
steps.exact_input: Middle row: Stripped Acacia Log, Stripped Acacia Log, Stripped Acacia Log; bottom row: Stripped Acacia Log, Stripped Acacia Log, empty
steps.success_cue: The grid contains two Chains in the top corners and five Stripped Acacia Logs across the full middle row and the first two cells of the bottom row; only the bottom-right intended ingredient cell remains empty.

steps.action: Trigger the reproduction by placing exactly one Stripped Acacia Log into the bottom-right crafting-grid cell. Do not remove ingredients, substitute oak logs, click a recipe-book entry, or interact with the output slot after this placement. Hand control to the observation subsystem immediately.
steps.exact_input: right-click the bottom-right crafting-grid cell once while holding Stripped Acacia Log
steps.success_cue: The intended hanging-sign pattern is complete: Chains occupy the two top corners, the top-center cell is empty, and all six cells in the middle and bottom rows contain one Stripped Acacia Log each. No output-slot interaction has occurred.

stor.handoff_condition: The sixth Stripped Acacia Log has just been placed in the bottom-right cell, completing the intended two-Chain and six-Stripped-Acacia-Log recipe pattern in the 22w42a Crafting Table. The crafting interface is still open and the output slot has not been clicked; begin observation now.
uncertainties: The report does not specify single-player versus multiplayer, game mode, seed, coordinates, or difficulty. An unmodded single-player Creative world is selected as the simplest deterministic environment because none of those omitted conditions appears necessary for the crafting action.

The report does not explicitly mention enabling experimental features. External version documentation confirms that hanging signs in 22w42a require the Update 1.20 built-in experimental data pack to be enabled while creating the world.
The exact visible label of the built-in pack may differ by language or UI presentation; it is referred to as the Update 1.20 experimental pack and is associated with the internal name update_1_20.
The /recipe command and recipe-book search are explicitly optional in the report. They are preserved as an optional diagnostic, while the manual ingredient placement is used as the primary trigger.

The report supplies the ingredient types and quantities but not the cell-by-cell layout. The layout with Chains in the top corners and six matching stripped logs filling the bottom two rows was externally verified.
